say:1:1310508001:0.text: Hello, Sir. Could we take a moment of your time?
say:1:1310508001:0.source_cn: 你好，这位先生，我们能占用你一些时间吗？

say:2:1310508002:0.text: Go away! I don't believe in any gods except Dura!
say:2:1310508002:0.source_cn: 走开走开，除了艾雅，我哪个神都不信！

say:3:1310508003:0.text: Huh? We just wanted to ask a question...
say:3:1310508003:0.source_cn: 啊？我们……只是想问个问题……

say:4:1310508004:0.text: What? You're... not here to preach? I'm so tired of hearing about the "Supreme Deity" recently...
say:4:1310508004:0.source_cn: 嗐……你们不是传教的啊！实在对不住，最近总是有人来说什...

say:7:1310508006:0.text: Hmm, I've seen one around here. Let me think...

say:9:1310508008:0.text: It began in the past few months. People claim that the "true god" personally answers their prayers...
say:9:1310508008:0.source_cn: 我就是近三四个月才听说的，那些人说什么真神会亲自回应信...

say:10:1310508009:0.text: But I swear upon Dura, my ancestors have lived in Whiteridge for generations, and I've never heard of such a god!
say:10:1310508009:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我祖祖辈辈住在白山，可从没听过这么个神！

say:13:1310508011:0.text: Are there many ruins around here?

say:14:1310508012:0.text: Yes. This place was a battlefield during the Divine War. It may not have been the most intense area, but many warriors fell here.
say:14:1310508012:0.source_cn: 是啊！神魔战争那会儿，这里是战场。虽然不是打得最激烈的...
